item.title: Grunkemeyer throws two TDs as Penn State beats Clemson 22-10 in Pinstripe Bowl
item.description: Ethan Grunkemeyer threw for a career-high 262 yards and two TDs, including a 73-yard strike to Trebor Pena early in the fourth quarter, and Penn State beat Clemson 22-10 Saturday afternoon in the Pinstripe Bowl. The post Grunkemeyer throws two TDs as Penn State beats Clemson 22-10 in Pinstripe Bowl appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: No. 12 BYU rallies to beat No. 24 Georgia Tech 25-21 to win Pop-Tarts Bowl
item.description: Jovesa Damuni scored on a 4-yard run with two minutes remaining and No. 12 BYU rallied from an 11-point deficit in the second half for a 25-21 win over No. 24 Georgia Tech on Saturday in the Pop-Tarts Bowl. The post No. 12 BYU rallies to beat No. 24 Georgia Tech 25-21 to win Pop-Tarts Bowl appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Report: 30% of Georgia’s data centers traced to 2018 tax break
item.description: Only 30% of Georgia's data center boom can be attributed to 2018 tax break intended to support the industry, according to a report released Wednesday from the State Department of Audits and Accounts. The post Report: 30% of Georgia’s data centers traced to 2018 tax break appeared first on The Augusta Press.
